Observables module

GPD ansatz and observable calculations with QCD evolution.

The GPD ansatz follows the moment-space form \(N\,x^{-\alpha}(1-x)^{\beta}\) (see Parameters). Starting from those ansatz parameters, this module computes:

  • t-dependent PDFs (GPDobserv.tPDF()) via inverse Mellin transform.

  • GPDs in \(x\)-space (GPDobserv.GPD(), GPDobserv.GPDNLO_evMom()) via Mellin-Barnes contour integration.

  • Compton Form Factors (CFFs, GPDobserv.CFF(), GPDobserv.CFFNLO(), GPDobserv.CFFNLO_evMom()) for DVCS.

  • Transition Form Factors (TFFs, GPDobserv.TFF(), GPDobserv.TFFNLO(), GPDobserv.TFFNLO_evMom()) for DVMP.

  • Generalized Form Factors (GPDobserv.GFFj0()).

All integrals use conformal (Mellin-Barnes) contours and support both leading-order (LO, p_order=1) and next-to-leading-order (NLO, p_order=2) QCD evolution.

CFF(ParaAll: ndarray, muf: float, p_order: int = 1, flv: str = 'All') → ndarray[source]

Charge-weighted Compton Form Factor \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\).

Computes \(\mathcal{F} = Q_u^2 F_u + Q_d^2 F_d\) via a Mellin-Barnes contour integral. Dispatches to CFFNLO() automatically when p_order=2.

Parameters:

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

    Flavor axis order: [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g].

  • muf (float) – factorization scale in GeV.

  • p_order (int) – perturbative order — 1 for LO (default), 2 for NLO.

  • flv (str) – flavor filter — 'All', 'q', or 'g'.

Returns:

\(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t) = Q_u^2 F_u + Q_d^2 F_d\).

Return type:

np.ndarray

CFFNLO(ParaAll: ndarray, muf: float, flv: str = 'All') → ndarray[source]

NLO Compton Form Factor \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) via evolved Wilson coefficients.

Implements the NLO CFF using the evolved-Wilson-coefficient (evWC) method. Can be called directly or via CFF() with p_order=2.

Parameters:

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

    Flavor axis order: [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g].

  • muf (float) – factorization scale in GeV.

  • flv (str) – flavor filter — 'All', 'q', or 'g'.

Returns:

NLO \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\).

Return type:

np.ndarray

CFFNLO_evMom(ParaAll: ndarray, muf: float, flv: str = 'All') → ndarray[source]

NLO Compton Form Factor \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) via evolved moments.

Alternative NLO implementation using moment evolution (Evolution.CFF_Evo_NLO_evMOM()) instead of evolved Wilson coefficients. Both methods produce numerically consistent results and can be used to cross-check each other.

The \(j = 0\) pole term is added back using the evWC method because the double-sum formula excludes it by construction. For the same reason a \(j = 1\) pole term is also restored.

Parameters:

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

    Flavor axis order: [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g].

  • muf (float) – factorization scale in GeV.

  • flv (str) – flavor filter — 'All', 'q', or 'g'.

Returns:

NLO \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) (evolved-moment method).

Return type:

np.ndarray

GFFj0(j: int, flv: str, ParaAll: ndarray, p_order: int) → float[source]

Generalized Form Factor \(A_{j+1,0}(t)\) (the \(\xi^0\) Mellin moment).

Computes \(\int dx\, x^j F(x, \xi, t)\) for quarks and \(\int dx\, x^{j-1} F(x, \xi, t)\) for gluons at \(\xi = 0\).

Note

Only LO and NLO evolution are implemented. Gluon GPDs reduce to \(x g(x)\), so there is a moment index shift relative to quarks. This method is not well-maintained and is marked for future revision.

Parameters:

  • j (int) – Mellin moment index (\(n = j + 1\)).

  • flv (str) – flavor — 'u', 'd', 'g', 'S', or 'NS'.

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) – shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array; only the \(\xi^0\) slice is used.

  • p_order (int) – perturbative order — 1 for LO, 2 for NLO.

Returns:

\(A_{j+1,0}(t)\) for the requested flavor.

Return type:

float

GPD(flv: str, ParaAll: ndarray, p_order: int = 1) → float[source]

GPD \(F(x, \xi, t)\) in flavor space.

Evaluates the GPD at the kinematics (self.x, self.xi, self.t) using a Mellin-Barnes contour integral. Dispatches to GPDNLO_evMom() automatically when p_order=2.

Parameters:

  • flv (str) – flavor — 'u', 'd', 'g', 'S', or 'NS'.

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters; flavors [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g]

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

  • p_order (int) – perturbative order — 1 for LO (default), 2 for NLO.

Returns:

\(F(x, \xi, t)\) for the requested flavor.

Return type:

float

GPDNLO_evMom(flv: str, ParaAll: ndarray) → float[source]

NLO GPD \(F(x, \xi, t)\) using the evolved-moment method.

Equivalent to GPD() with p_order=2 but uses moment evolution (Evolution.GPD_Moment_Evo_NLO()) instead of evolved Wilson coefficients. Both approaches yield numerically consistent results.

Parameters:

  • flv (str) – flavor — 'u', 'd', 'g', 'S', or 'NS'.

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters; flavors [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g]

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

Returns:

\(F(x, \xi, t)\) for the requested flavor at NLO.

Return type:

float

TFF(ParaAll: ndarray, muf: float, meson: int, p_order: int = 1, flv: str = 'All') → ndarray[source]

Transition Form Factor \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) for meson production.

Computes the TFF via a Mellin-Barnes contour integral. Dispatches to TFFNLO() automatically when p_order=2.

Parameters:

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

    Flavor axis order: [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g].

  • muf (float) – factorization scale in GeV.

  • meson (int) – meson code — 1 for \(\rho^0\), 2 for \(\phi\), 3 for \(J/\psi\).

  • p_order (int) – perturbative order — 1 for LO (default), 2 for NLO.

  • flv (str) – flavor filter — 'All', 'q', or 'g'.

Returns:

\(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) for the requested meson.

Return type:

np.ndarray

TFFNLO_evMom(ParaAll: ndarray, muf: float, meson: int, flv: str = 'All') → ndarray[source]

NLO Transition Form Factor \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) via evolved moments.

Alternative NLO implementation using moment evolution (Evolution.TFF_Evo_NLO_evMOM()) instead of evolved Wilson coefficients. Both methods produce numerically consistent results and can be used to cross-check each other.

The \(j = 0\) and \(j = 1\) pole terms are added back separately (see CFFNLO_evMom() for the rationale).

Parameters:

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) –

    shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array with slices:

    • [..., 0, ...] — \(\xi^0\) (forward) parameters

    • [..., 1, ...] — \(\xi^2\) correction parameters

    • [..., 2, ...] — \(\xi^4\) correction parameters

    Flavor axis order: [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g].

  • muf (float) – factorization scale in GeV.

  • meson (int) – meson code — 1 for \(\rho^0\), 2 for \(\phi\), 3 for \(J/\psi\).

  • flv (str) – flavor filter — 'All', 'q', or 'g'.

Returns:

NLO \(\mathcal{F}(\xi, t)\) for the requested meson (evolved-moment method).

Return type:

np.ndarray

tPDF(flv: str, ParaAll: ndarray, p_order: int = 1) → ndarray[source]

t-dependent PDF \(f(x, t)\) for a given flavor.

Computes the impact-parameter-space PDF via the inverse Mellin transform along a straight contour with real part reS = 1.25.

See also: Evolution.Moment_Evo_LO(), Evolution.tPDF_Moment_Evo_NLO().

Parameters:

  • flv (str) – flavor — 'u', 'd', 'g', 'S', or 'NS'.

  • ParaAll (np.ndarray) – shape (..., 3, 5, n_ansatz, 6) parameter array. ParaAll[..., 0, ...] contains the forward (\(\xi^0\)) parameters for the five flavors [uV, ubar, dV, dbar, g]; the \(\xi^2\) slice is accepted for interface consistency but is not used here.

  • p_order (int) – perturbative order — 1 for LO (default), 2 for NLO.

Returns:

\(f(x, t)\) for the requested flavor.

Return type:

np.ndarray

gumpgpd.Observables.flvmask(flv: str) → ndarray[source]

Return a binary flavor mask in the evolution basis.

Used to project evolved conformal moments onto a quark, gluon, or all-flavor combination when computing CFFs and TFFs.

Parameters:

flv (str) – 'All' (all flavors), 'q' (quarks only), or 'g' (gluon only).

Returns:

length-5 integer mask, with 1 for active and 0 for inactive flavors in the evolution basis [uV, u-bar, dV, d-bar, g].

Return type:

np.ndarray
